verdict.rationale: dlt's CLI is documented to create, add, inspect and deploy pipelines, and its Python API runs a pipeline in a few lines (`dlt.pipeline(...)`, `pipeline.run`). `dlt-init-openapi` scaffolds pipelines from OpenAPI specs, and the dltHub AI Harness (skills, rules, MCP servers) is explicitly built so coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex can build, deploy (`dlthub deploy`) and run pipelines. All of this is first-party documentation, plus an MCP server for managing secrets, schemas and runs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of an agent driving a full headless run, and detailed docs on headless configuration and credential setup through the CLI.
